objective: Launch the pinned Mugi V1 contracts-only source on Ethereum mainnet. Import this exact Foundry repository and inspect README.md, foundry.toml, inventory.json, launch.json, src/imd, and test/imd. The IMD launch transaction must create and record exactly these four contracts in this order: MugiIMDCrewFactory, MugiV1IMDDeploymentFactory, MugiIMDAccountingFactory, MugiIMDEngineFactory. Their static constructor arguments are exactly those in launch.json and the manifest repeated below. There are no constructor-created children, value payments, or post-deployment calls in this IMD transaction. This is evm_contracts; do not add a standard launch token, distributor, pool, swarm token allocation, or token launch economics. Preserve the tested contract source and compiler settings (Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer 200, viaIR, bytecode_hash none); packaging/manifest adaptation is allowed. If a source change is necessary, report the blocking reason rather than automatically deploying changed code. The protocol owner is 0x20714d50f4675c366de30b603728a90ddddb240f. The deployment factory's committed hook initcode hash is 0xbc3c1605ac7a5e7781e7923e764c5e673c9480991b0d532f1799b78af4ac4359; it must not be changed or replaced. FULL FOLLOW-ON LIFECYCLE DISCLOSURE: after this IMD factory deployment, the owner calls these factories to deploy the hash-pinned hook at its permission-bit CREATE2 address, ten full crew ERC20 contracts, the airdrop, Chainlink VRF adapter, IMD plan verifier, swap router, and separate hook-bound ledger, buyback, price-oracle and V4 liquidity-engine modules. These ordinary contracts use CALL with explicit authorization, not proxies or delegatecall. The owner binds modules and configures the season, funds ten V4 pools separately, then a public relayer can activate after 100 registrations or seven days, provided every pool is seeded. Crew tokens intentionally implement hook-controlled mint/burn and transfer restrictions tied to elimination and settlement; the owner can pause trading while claims and lifecycle settlement retain their defined paths. Disclose these intentional rules to source admission; do not silently remove pause or replace the tokens with unrestricted ERC20 semantics. Liquidity is controlled by the hook-bound engine, with a prelaunch abort recovery and final migration to a manually selected V2 target. Confirm this disclosed factory/follow-on architecture is accepted by evm_contracts source admission; do not conceal descendants or claim each will be an independent Explorer launch entry. Return the IMD launch record, four recorded addresses, submitted transaction references, and final source commit. Do not submit source verification to Etherscan, Blockscout, Sourcify, or any explorer. If the platform requires source verification, stop with needs_input before deployment and explain the requirement.
